This agrees with the listening notes’ flute statement and clarinet restatement near 13 and 56 s; chroma itself does not identify either instrument. candidatesRejected: Most of the 135 retained candidates are late, broad matches over the unchanged C/G foundation. The longest spans cross different melody statements and have low contrast, so they are not published as repeated tunes. Boléro’s two-bar snare ostinato is a continuous rhythmic pattern, not a formal return and not something CENS can identify. No additional arc is inferred from the final E-major shift.
